mapper.sql: ast06_tr_id AS tr_id, ast06_date AS date, ast06_tr_cd AS tr_code, f_cdnm('trCode', ast06_tr_cd, ast06_company_id, ast06_date) AS tr_name, ast06_note AS note, ast06_amt AS amt, ast06_settle_mng_yn AS settle_mng_yn, ast06_deposit_id AS deposit_id, f_ast_class_tree_nm(ast06_deposit_id) AS deposit_name, ast06_appr_id AS appr_id, apr01_status_cd AS appr_status_code, f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, ast06_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS appr_status_name, ast06_person_id AS person_id, f_emp_kor_nm(ast06_person_id) AS person_name, act02_journal_id AS journal_id, ast06_ast_class_tree_id AS ast_class_tree_id, ast20_tr_tax_id AS tr_tax_id, ast20_income_tax AS income_tax, ast20_local_tax AS local_tax, ast20_etc_tax AS etc_tax, ast20_pre_pay_vat AS pre_pay_vat, ast20_pre_rcv_vat AS pre_rcv_vat, ast21_tr_4insure_id AS tr4_insure_id, ast21_np_withholding AS np_withholding, ast21_np_company AS np_company, ast21_np_etc AS np_etc, ast21_np_etc_note AS np_etc_note, ast21_hi_withholding AS hi_withholding, ast21_hi_company AS hi_company, ast21_hi_etc AS hi_etc, ast21_hi_etc_note AS hi_etc_note, ast21_ei_withholding AS ei_withholding, ast21_ei_company AS ei_company, ast21_ei_etc AS ei_etc, ast21_ei_etc_note AS ei_etc_note, ast21_oh_company AS oh_company, ast21_oh_etc AS oh_etc, ast21_oh_etc_note AS oh_etc_note, CASE WHEN ast06_tr_cd = '5052' /*(5052:4대보험납부)*/ THEN COALESCE(ast21_np_withholding,0) + COALESCE(ast21_np_company ,0) + COALESCE(ast21_np_etc ,0) ELSE 0 END AS np_settle_amt, CASE WHEN ast06_tr_cd = '5052' THEN COALESCE(ast21_hi_withholding,0) + COALESCE(ast21_hi_company ,0) + COALESCE(ast21_hi_etc ,0) ELSE 0 END AS hi_settle_amt, CASE WHEN ast06_tr_cd = '5052' THEN COALESCE(ast21_ei_withholding,0) + COALESCE(ast21_ei_company ,0) + COALESCE(ast21_ei_etc ,0) ELSE 0 END AS ei_settle_amt, CASE WHEN ast06_tr_cd = '5052' THEN COALESCE(ast21_oh_company ,0) + COALESCE(ast21_oh_etc ,0) ELSE 0 END AS oh_settle_amt

FROM ast06_tr LEFT OUTER JOIN ast20_tr_tax ON ast20_tr_id = ast06_tr_id LEFT OUTER JOIN ast21_tr_4insure ON ast21_tr_id = ast06_tr_id LEFT OUTER JOIN act02_journal ON act02_tr_id = ast06_tr_id LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = ast06_appr_id , ( SELECT f_get_account_nm(act13_company_id, act13_real_account_cd) insure_account_nm FROM act13_real_account_map WHERE act13_company_id = #{companyId} AND act13_repr_account_cd = '5804' /*(5804:복리후생비계정)*/ AND act13_account_map LIKE '953003%' /*(953003:사대보험)*/ LIMIT 1 ) act
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ast06_tr (ast06_tr_id, ast06_company_id, ast06_person_id, ast06_date, ast06_tr_cd, ast06_amt, ast06_cont_amt, ast06_settle_mng_yn, ast06_note, ast06_deposit_id, ast06_ast_class_tree_id, ast06_cur_cd, ast06_fx_rate, ast06_for_amt, ast06_for_cont_amt) VALUES (#{trId}, #{companyId}, #{personId}, #{date}, #{trCode}, #{amt}, #{contAmt}, #{settleMngYn}, #{note}, #{depositId}, #{astClassTreeId}, 'KRW', 1.0, #{amt}, COALESCE(CAST(#{contAmt} AS numeric), #{amt}))
mapper.update: UPDATE ast06_tr SET ast06_amt = #{amt}, ast06_settle_mng_yn = #{settleMngYn}, ast06_note = #{note}, ast06_deposit_id = #{depositId}, ast06_for_amt = #{amt}, ast06_cont_amt = COALESCE(CAST(#{contAmt} AS numeric), ast06_cont_amt), ast06_for_cont_amt = COALESCE(CAST(#{contAmt} AS numeric), #{amt}) WHERE ast06_tr_id = #{trId} AND ast06_company_id = #{companyId}

mapper.update: UPDATE ast20_tr_tax SET ast20_income_tax = #{r.incomeTax}, ast20_local_tax = #{r.localTax}, ast20_etc_tax = #{r.etcTax}, ast20_pre_pay_vat = #{r.prePayVat}, ast20_pre_rcv_vat = #{r.preRcvVat} WHERE ast20_tr_tax_id = #{taxId}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ast21_tr_4insure (ast21_tr_4insure_id, ast21_tr_id, ast21_np_withholding, ast21_np_company, ast21_np_etc, ast21_np_etc_note, ast21_hi_withholding, ast21_hi_company, ast21_hi_etc, ast21_hi_etc_note, ast21_ei_withholding, ast21_ei_company, ast21_ei_etc, ast21_ei_etc_note, ast21_oh_company, ast21_oh_etc, ast21_oh_etc_note) VALUES (#{insureId}, #{trId}, #{r.npWithholding}, #{r.npCompany}, #{r.npEtc}, #{r.npEtcNote}, #{r.hiWithholding}, #{r.hiCompany}, #{r.hiEtc}, #{r.hiEtcNote}, #{r.eiWithholding}, #{r.eiCompany}, #{r.eiEtc}, #{r.eiEtcNote}, #{r.ohCompany}, #{r.ohEtc}, #{r.ohEtcNote})
mapper.update: UPDATE ast21_tr_4insure SET ast21_np_withholding = #{r.npWithholding}, ast21_np_company = #{r.npCompany}, ast21_np_etc = #{r.npEtc}, ast21_np_etc_note = #{r.npEtcNote}, ast21_hi_withholding = #{r.hiWithholding}, ast21_hi_company = #{r.hiCompany}, ast21_hi_etc = #{r.hiEtc}, ast21_hi_etc_note = #{r.hiEtcNote}, ast21_ei_withholding = #{r.eiWithholding}, ast21_ei_company = #{r.eiCompany}, ast21_ei_etc = #{r.eiEtc}, ast21_ei_etc_note = #{r.eiEtcNote}, ast21_oh_company = #{r.ohCompany}, ast21_oh_etc = #{r.ohEtc}, ast21_oh_etc_note = #{r.ohEtcNote} WHERE ast21_tr_4insure_id = #{insureId}
mapper.select: WITH ledger AS ( SELECT act13_repr_account_cd AS repr_account_cd , (act04_dr_today_bal_amt - act04_cr_today_bal_amt) * CASE WHEN act01_attribute_cd IN ('1','5','9') THEN 1 ELSE -1 END AS bal_amt FROM act04_gen_ledger INNER JOIN act01_account_code ON ( act01_company_id = act04_company_id AND act01_account_cd = act04_account_cd ) INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT act13_company_id, act13_repr_account_cd, act13_real_account_cd FROM act13_real_account_map WHERE act13_company_id = #{companyId} AND act13_account_map = '0000000000' AND act13_repr_account_cd IN ('1902','2700' ,'2604','2605','2606') ) act13 ON ( act13_company_id = act04_company_id AND act13_real_account_cd = act04_account_cd ) WHERE ( ( #{trCode} = '5050' /*(5050:원천세납부)이면 전월말일 잔액 */ AND act04_std_date = f_get_last_day(to_date(to_char(CAST(#{date} AS date),'yyyymm')||'01','yyyymmdd')-1) ) OR ( #{trCode} = '5051' /*(5051:부가세납부)이면 당일 잔액 */ AND act04_std_date = CAST(#{date} AS date) ) ) ) SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN repr_account_cd = '2604' THEN bal_amt ELSE 0 END) AS income_tax /* 2604 : 소득세예수금 계정 */ , SUM(CASE WHEN repr_account_cd = '2605' THEN bal_amt ELSE 0 END) AS local_tax /* 2605 : 지방세예수금 계정 */ , SUM(CASE WHEN repr_account_cd = '2606' THEN bal_amt ELSE 0 END) AS etc_tax /* 2606 : 기타원천징수예수금 계정 */ , SUM(CASE WHEN repr_account_cd = '1902' THEN bal_amt ELSE 0 END) AS pre_pay_vat /* 1902 : 선급부가세 계정 */ , SUM(CASE WHEN repr_account_cd = '2700' THEN bal_amt ELSE 0 END) AS pre_rcv_vat /* 2700 : 부가세예수금 계정 */ FROM ledger

WITH ledger AS ( SELECT act13_repr_account_cd AS repr_account_cd , (act04_dr_today_bal_amt - act04_cr_today_bal_amt) * CASE WHEN act01_attribute_cd IN ('1','5','9') THEN 1 ELSE -1 END AS bal_amt FROM act04_gen_ledger INNER JOIN act01_account_code ON ( act01_company_id = act04_company_id AND act01_account_cd = act04_account_cd ) INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT act13_company_id, act13_repr_account_cd, act13_real_account_cd FROM act13_real_account_map WHERE act13_company_id = #{companyId} AND act13_account_map = '0000000000' AND act13_repr_account_cd IN ('2601','2602','2603') ) act13 ON ( act13_company_id = act04_company_id AND act13_real_account_cd = act04_account_cd ) WHERE act04_std_date = f_get_last_day(to_date(to_char(CAST(#{date} AS date),'yyyymm')||'01','yyyymmdd')-1) ) SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN repr_account_cd = '2601' THEN bal_amt ELSE 0 END) AS np_withholding /* 2601 : 국민연금 예수금 계정 */ , SUM(CASE WHEN repr_account_cd = '2602' THEN bal_amt ELSE 0 END) AS hi_withholding /* 2602 : 건강보험 예수금 계정 */ , SUM(CASE WHEN repr_account_cd = '2603' THEN bal_amt ELSE 0 END) AS ei_withholding /* 2603 : 고용보험 예수금 계정 */ FROM ledger
